description:
Low Cut Connie's Adam Weiner describes some of his Twin Cities favorites
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Adam Weiner of Low Cut Connie played a show at the Turf Club in St. Paul on Saturday, then visited The Current on Monday. That raises the question: How does Adam like to spend his free time in the Twin Cities? “I always try to have a day off in the Twin Cities,” Adam says, “and I’ve got all my spots.” 

In an interview with The Current’s Jill Riley, Adam Weiner describes a handful of his favorite pastimes in Minneapolis and St. Paul.

description:
Watch Gogol Bordello perform "Life Is Possible" live in studio
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Combining the sounds of punk rock, electronica and Eastern European folk, New York-based rock band Gogol Bordello are always pushing new musical boundaries. Their latest album, We Mean It, Man!, released on February 13, 2026, and it continues to showcase the band’s ever-growing sound. 

Shortly after the album’s release, Gogol Bordello visited The Current studio for a session hosted by Jill Riley. Watch a performance of "Life Is Possible" above.

Musicians
Eugene Hütz – vocals, guitar
Sergey Ryabtsev – vocals, electric violin
Erica Mancini – vocals, synth, accordion
Pedro Segovia – vocals, sampler, cajon and other percussion

author: The Current
description:
Jason Isbell talks about his first visit to Minnesota and trying new foods
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

During the March 5 concert by Jason Isbell and the 400 Unit at the Armory in Minneapolis, Jason Isbell took a moment to share his memories about the very first time he visited Minneapolis. Isbell recalls very vividly visiting the Cedar-Riverside neighborhood, where he tasted Somali food for the first time. “It was the first time I'd ever eaten anything that wasn't from Alabama or Mexico or Italy,” he says. “And I was astounded … It opened my eyes.”

Find a recap and photos from Jason Isbell and the 400 Unit’s “A Concert for Minnesota” posted at https://www.thecurrent.org/feature/2026/03/06/jason-isbell-and-the-400-unit-the-armory-a-concert-for-minnesota-recap
